content:
Alyssa Chen: Drafting a one-pager for field — working title 'Velocity Brief'. Audience: security-first enterprise buyers. Goal: 1) clear benchmark narrative, 2) tight webinar hook, 3) inbound routing rules for MQLs mentioning security, SLAs or private deploys. Posting the short draft below and asking for quick takes.

Mike R: Uploaded draft to Drive: https://drive.redwood/velocity-brief-draft :thumbsup: Quick thought on headline — avoid absolutes. Maybe: 'Up to 3x lower median latency and meaningful per-token savings in our production benchmarks.'

Jordan Lee: +1 on wording. Suggest adding benchmark context: test workload = 2k-token prompts, mixed chat/generation, steady-state throughput. Our internal run vs a common managed endpoint showed median latency improvement from ~280ms -> ~95ms at 4 concurrent streams; cost delta ~40% lower per generated token when using batching + prefix caching. Put those numbers into a small callout box.

Samira Patel: For field handoff we need explicit inbound routing rules. Proposed simple rule set below — puts security/privacy flagged leads straight to AE+SE queue and schedules a Solutions Workshop. Can we standardize tags?

Samira Patel: ```
# inbound routing pseudo-config
if lead.tags contains any of ["security", "private-deploy", "on-prem", "vpc"] then:
  assign.team = "enterprise-ae"
  assign.people = ["AE-priority", "SE-security"]
  followup = "schedule-solutions-workshop"
else if lead.activity indicates webinar_signup and lead.size >= 100:
  assign.team = "growth-ae"
  nurture = "webinar-nurture-1wk"
end
```

Noah Gomez: Love that. Also add a checkbox in the form: "Does your use case require a private/VPC or dedicated capacity?" — if yes, auto-tag. Sample webinar CTA can say 'See private deployments in action + SLA walkthrough'.

Jordan Lee: For the webinar hook: 20 minute bench walkthrough + 25 minute live Q&A with SE + 15 minute breakout for compliance buyers. Title idea: 'Serving Securely: Meeting SLAs and Cost Targets for Enterprise LLMs' — we can A/B test a more product-y title vs compliance-y title in email invites.

Mike R: For the one-pager layout: Top left: 1-line problem statement (security + predictability). Top right: benchmark callout (numbers + small methodology blurb). Mid: deployment options matrix (hosted/dedicated/private) with bullets on SLAs, isolation, and pricing profile. Bottom: CTA + routing rules snippet + webinar invite.

Alyssa Chen: Great, thanks team. Action items: Mike — finalize copy and small methodology note by EOD. Jordan — prepare a 2-slide benchmark visual (median + p99, cost chart). Samira/Noah — finalize inbound routing config and form update; Samira add exact tags. I'll assemble the one-pager and schedule a 30-min sync tomorrow to finalize webinar details. :calendar:

marketing-bot: Reminder set: 'Velocity Brief finalize' tomorrow 10:00 AM PST.
